title: My scores
subtitle: Log your score for each day and mode and follow your gains and losses by day, week and season.

help.text1: Fill in each mode's score on the game day (the day turns at 12:00). Day, week and season (28-day cycle) totals are calculated for you.
help.text2: Saved on this device and, if you sign in, in your account too. Only you can see your scores.

locked.title: Unlocks today at 22:00
locked.text: Scores start counting at today's weekly reset (10/22, 22:00 Brasília time), so every day, week and season adds up correctly.

cards.todayFooter: Sum of the day's modes · change from the last day of the same kind (BAI vs. BAI)
cards.weekFooter: Week total · change from the previous week up to the same day

entry.title: Log score
entry.subtitle: Pick the day and write how much you scored in each mode. Saves when you leave the field; clearing the number removes it.
entry.invalid: Numbers only (you can use separators for thousands).
entry.noTeam: You haven't built a team for this day.

chart.title: Performance
chart.subtitle: Points per day and per mode each week, and how much you gained or lost compared to the previous period.
chart.dailyDelta: Gain or loss vs. the last day of the same kind (BAI vs. BAI)
chart.weeklyDelta: Gain or loss vs. previous week
chart.empty: Log a day's score to see the charts.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Everything you logged. Tap a row to edit that day.
